functionalReqs: Generate N images from a prompt (sizes and styles)
Free and paid tiers with credits
hints: Each request holds a GPU for seconds. Is a synchronous HTTP request the right shape?
Think about queues per tier, batching compatible requests, and what can be cached.

API accepts the job → prompt safety check → priority queue per tier → GPU workers (diffusion model, fewer steps or distilled models for fast tier, batching same-resolution requests) → output safety classifier → object store + CDN → client notified via WebSocket/polling; credits deducted on success; autoscale on queue depth with spot GPUs for low priority.
nonFunctionalReqs: Typical generation in 5–15 s, with progress updates
No unsafe or policy-violating images delivered
Efficient GPU use under bursty demand
problemStatement: Design a **text-to-image generation service** (like DALL·E or Midjourney): users type a prompt and receive images within seconds, with variations, upscaling and safety filtering.

scaleHints.qps: ~2K generation requests/s at peak; each takes seconds of GPU time
scaleHints.storage: Billions of images in object storage

title: Design an Image Generation Service
